title: Teaser card peeking out of an artboard collage
summary: A still collage of design artboards over giant cropped type; a cursor drifts to one artboard, a teaser card grows out of it with a masked three-line headline and pill buttons, folds back, then repeats from a second artboard.
use_when: Pre-launch teaser where the feature itself must stay hidden
Design, template or creative tools whose output is a set of artboards or formats
Silent social loop that announces a release date or waitlist
Short looping header or hero clip for a launch page

look.type_style: teaser headline: geometric sans, regular weight, uppercase, 3 stacked lines, about 9 % H per line, tight leading; backdrop word: heavy grotesk about 30 % H, cropped by the cards; artboard labels: small sans with tiny pill tags

sfx.event: teaser card grows out of an artboard
pill buttons land on the card
teaser card folds back into the collage

structure.shot: warm grey collage: five portrait and square artboards with pixel art over a giant cropped dark word; cursor enters
structure.motion: cursor glides to the lower-left square artboard, springs via Cursor path, about 23 fr (±0.25 s), then rests on it

structure.shot: teaser card grows out of the hovered artboard: headline 3 words on 3 lines, clipped by the card, then 3 pill buttons with a 2-word label
structure.motion: card scale-up from the artboard rect with a fade, springs.layout about 8-15 fr (±0.25 s, overshoot not measurable); headline lines uncovered by the card edge; pills land by 2.00, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); cursor hovers pill to pill over 1.5 s

structure.shot: card folds back and fades, collage alone again; cursor travels to the orange square artboard and hovers it
structure.motion: card collapse plus fade, easings.inExpo about 8 fr (±0.25 s), gone by 4.27; cursor move over about 30 fr (±0.25 s), hover 1.5 s

structure.shot: same teaser card grows out of the second artboard, lines appear one per cell through the card mask, then the pills
structure.motion: card springs.layout about 8 fr (±0.25 s); headline line stagger about 7 fr (±0.25 s): 1 line at 6.77, 2 at 7.00, 3 plus pills at 7.27; cursor hovers the lower pill

structure.shot: card folds back into the collage; collage holds with the cursor parked low, matching the first frame for the loop
structure.motion: collapse plus fade easings.inExpo about 8 fr (±0.25 s), gone by 9.77; cursor drifts down and rests

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (warm neutral), fg for the backdrop word, surface for the cards, accent plus two secondary colours for the pills
params.content.backdropWord: one big word (product name) set behind the collage, cropped by the cards
params.content.artboards: 5 images or artboards with a size label, scattered at fixed positions
params.content.headline: teaser headline, 3 short words, one per line
params.content.peekFrom: indexes of the 2 artboards the card grows out of (default square-left, then square-centre)
params.timing.hold: frames the card holds open (default 67 = 2.25 s)

notes: Single shot, no cuts, silent. Two identical peeks: card open 1.50-4.00 and 6.77-9.50, about 2.5 s each, collage alone 2.77 s between them. The background never moves; motion.json reports a constant -19,17 px/s pan and -5.4 %/s zoom, but cards sit at the same place at 0.00 and 10.77, so it is an estimator artefact. Loopable: last cell matches the first. Proposed terms (not used as ids): thumb-expand, backdrop-type. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
